mapper.select: SELECT menu_id FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_type = 1 AND target_id = #{roleId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON m.id = p.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON p.target_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_type = 1 AND m.status = 1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON m.id = p.menu_id WHERE p.target_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_type = 2 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort
